scope: Dedicated CI crosvm build tree only; all Android device Rust crates built for the selected crosvm target inherit this default, including transitive Rust/stdlib dependencies
limits: Source configuration is not a device panic/RM execution result
Soong device rust_test still adds -Z panic_abort_tests; portable smoke uses explicit host unwind and does not establish device behavior
Fatal C signals, direct _exit, non-unwinding FFI panic, OOM abort and SIGKILL remain outside unwind guarantees
